_comment: Instagram accounts the All Day photo feed reads (the Wire's Photos view, Food's Their food, Vintage's New in). HAND-CURATED: nobody's posts get in unless their handle is here, except the @btownbrief tagged shelf. One object per account. `name` (optional) is what a reader sees instead of the handle; without it the account's own profile name is used, once a read has found it. `interest` (optional) puts an account in one of the Wire's feeds (dogs, home, plants, laughs, sports, wild), and `breed` (beagle or lab) in Dog people's Beagles or Labs chip. A tier 3 account with an `interest` is read every three days, because its pictures last about four. `tier` is how often we pay one Scrape Creators credit to check it: 1 = every run (twice a day), 2 = once a Burlington day, 3 = once a week, rotating, an even slice a day. `category` is what kind of picture it is, for the Photos chips: food, venue (bars, cafes, music venues: the vibe checks), events (posters and the accounts that post them), shop (vintage), pets, scenic (photographers, city and landscape accounts), other. `food: true` puts a non-food account's posts on the Food tab as well (a bar, a brewery). `s: see` marks the creator accounts the retired Instagram tab showed in its SEE half; it is carried on posts for older readers and means nothing else. The monthly credit budget is MONTHLY_CREDIT_BUDGET in scripts/build_instagram.py; `python3 scripts/build_instagram.py --dry-run` prints what a roster costs. Vetting: the original DO handles in the newsletter's reference/instagram-sources.md, SEE handles 2026-08-30 against the live profile API, restaurants (PR #308) and vintage shops (PR #311) as linked from each business's own website, and the 2026-10-17 venue, events, pets and scenic additions the same way. `national: true` (with category `national`) marks an account from away: its posts carry `n: 1`, show under National and Everything only, and never reach Food, Vintage, People or Town. The 22 national accounts were each confirmed on Instagram on 2026-10-30 from a public profile page; 27 quiet local accounts moved from tier 2 to tier 3 the same day to pay for them. The 21 dog and home accounts added 2026-11-01 were each read through the live API, and only ones with posts in the last 30 days were kept; those that post about daily are tier 2, the rest get the feeds' three-day read. A dormant account still costs its credit, so prune ones that stop posting.

photo_categories._comment: Additional editorial tags for accounts that belong to several Photos filters. Primary categories come from accounts; these retain intentional overlaps such as a cat cafe being pets and a vibe check.
